Keyboard technical work: keyboard exercise (G1-8; none at Initial) then scales & chord knowledge or exercises; organ: scales (G1), scales & arpeggios (G2-5), plus pedal study at G6-8. Supporting tests: Initial-G5 any two of sight reading, aural, improvisation, musical knowledge (10 each); G6-8 sight reading (10) plus aural or improvisation (10). Distinction 87-100, Merit 75-86, Pass 60-74, Below Pass 1 45-59, Below Pass 2 0-44; per piece D 19-22, M 16-18, P 13-15. No need to pass every section. UCAS points G6 8/10/12, G7 12/14/16, G8 18/24/30 (pass/merit/distinction). Digital technical-work pathway: 3 pieces at 22 (66) + technical work 14 + overall performance 20 = 100; no supporting tests; choose scales/chords (or scales & arpeggios for organ) set A or B, or two exercises (keyboard). Digital repertoire-only pathway: 4 pieces at 25 each = 100.

Electronic Keyboard: 3 pieces from the repertoire list; own composition may replace one (Initial-G5); at G6-8 also own-choice piece or own arrangement (keyboard or non-keyboard, of similar demand, not pre-approved). Each graded book has one own-interpretation option (candidate chooses voices/style; auto intros/endings not allowed). Single-fingered or fully fingered chords allowed; efficient set-up expected. Organ: 3 pieces in groups A and B, at least one from each; own composition may replace one; prepare in full, observe short repeats only. Own composition lengths 0.5-1 min at Initial to 3.5-5 min at G8; stave notation G6-8. Memory optional; no metronome.
None. No theory or lower-grade prerequisite; each grade assumes confidence in earlier requirements. Organ has no Initial grade (starts at Grade 1).

Digital exams are filmed in one continuous take and uploaded. Technical-work pathway: 3 pieces, technical work (keyboard exercise then scales/chords set A or B or two exercises; organ scales & arpeggios set A or B plus pedal study at G6-8), overall performance mark, no supporting tests. Repertoire-only pathway: 4 pieces. Own composition allowed.
sections: Scales & technical work

Prepare all; examiner selects; from memory (pedal study may use music). Manual, two octaves, min q=132: Bb and Eb melodic minor; D, G, Bb major in 3rds; B, E, G melodic minor in 3rds; chromatic in minor 3rds and major 6ths; arpeggios: dominant 7ths in F, Ab, Eb, F# and diminished 7ths on Ab, Bb, C# (q=80). Sight-reading
B, Db major, G# and Bb minor (double sharps/flats), changing time signatures, duplets/triplets, changes of registration.
Aural & other tests

Sight reading plus aural or improvisation. Aural (12-16 bar harmonised): time signature, dynamics, articulation, three other characteristics; locate three changes (pitch/rhythm). Improv: 16 bars, C#/F minor, 7ths, 9ths, suspensions.

General rules (all instruments)

Both LRSM and FRSM programmes must be balanced and varied: a variety of moods, keys and tempi and at least two pieces or movements contrasting by period or style. Works and movements must be played complete unless the repertoire list says otherwise, and any list-specific instructions must be followed. Music published with an accompaniment must be performed with one; any suitable instrument may accompany provided the candidate stays the main soloist, candidates arrange their own accompanist, and pre-recorded accompaniments are not allowed unless the composer intended them. Memory is not required (but encouraged if it helps). Any edition matching the list entry may be used and own-choice music must exist as a legible, fully notated score; performing from unauthorised photocopies of copyright editions is not allowed. Own-choice may include the candidate's own composition or arrangement but must still be at or above the required standard, and ABRSM cannot give prior approval of own-choice standard. An audience is encouraged but not required. Infringements (wrong length, too much own choice without approval, wrong movements, edited video) can bring a warning, mark deduction or disqualification. A video can only ever be submitted once, and the same Unit 2 work cannot be reused at a higher level.
